title: Mixed Event — Connected Through SEKAI's Cherry Blossoms — Episode2 Looking For Cherry Blossoms

meta.Event Outline: In the Empty SEKAI, Miku's words inspire a discussion among Kanade and the others about having a cherry blossom viewing party. Meanwhile, everyone in the other SEKAI is also planning ways to make the most of the season...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (I keep walking, but there's nothing here...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Haven't any cherry blossom trees appeared yet...?)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
(Hmm...
I might try looking more over there.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
(I think I'm getting tired.
Time for a break...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (There really aren't any cherry blossom trees... But not just trees...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (There used to be even less here.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (In the beginning, it was just Mafuyu and me in this SEKAI.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (It was just a white, empty space...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (But Mafuyu kept making music despite everything she was going through.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: You've been waiting? Then you know who we are?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Seriously?
Does that mean you're the one who brought us here?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No way. So this isn't like a dream or something?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (This SEKAI has Kanade and the others now...)
You want to help her that much?
Then allow me to join you.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But there are also things you become blind to by getting too close...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That's why I'd like to maintain my distance and observe them for now.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
It's nice to finally meet you all.
Miku's told me all about you.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (They all show it in different ways, but they care about Mafuyu and the others very much...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (More and more people began appearing in this SEKAI...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (It's become a little livelier than before.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (And Mafuyu's begun to change a little bit at a time...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (There may not be any cherry blossom trees, but I have everyone else here with me...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (So I'm happy as long as I'm able to spend time with them.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (I'm glad I went looking for one like this since it led me to this realization...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I want to keep doing what I can for everybody moving forward...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
(I should head back soon...
Rin and the others will start worrying if I'm away for too long.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Huh...?
There's something sparkling on the ground.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh... Is this a fragment of a feeling?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (A fragment of a feeling... Someone's feelings that are yet to become its own SEKAI...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (SEKAI are born out of people's feelings, but not all of these feelings can turn into SEKAI...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (As a result, some feelings appear in this form from time to time.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (And it's possible to see some of this person's feelings by touching it.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (It's glowing... But I haven't touched it yet...)
